, also known as Bleach: The Blood Warfare, is a Japanese anime television series based on Tite Kubo's manga series Bleach and a direct sequel to its predecessor anime series of the same name. In March 2020, Weekly Shōnen Jump and "Bleach 20th Anniversary Project & Tite Kubo New Project Presentation" livestream announced that the manga's final story arc, the "Thousand-Year Blood War", would receive an anime project. In November 2020, it was confirmed that the anime project would be a television series adapting the entirety of the arc. The trailer and visual for the series were revealed at the Jump Festa in December 2021.
The series is directed by Tomohisa Taguchi and written by . It premiered on TV Tokyo in October 2022. The series will run for four cours with off-season breaks in between. The first cours, subtitled The Blood Warfare, consists of 13 episodes and ended in December of the same year. The second cours, subtitled , also consists of 13 episodes and was broadcast from July to September 2023. The third cours, subtitled , consisting of 14 episodes, aired from October to December 2024. The fourth and final cours, subtitled , is set to premiere in 2026.
For The Blood Warfare cours, the opening theme song is "|スカー|Sukā}}, performed by Tatsuya Kitani, while the ending theme song is }}, performed by SennaRin; in addition, Kitani also performed the special ending theme song for the first episode, "", which was previously used as the theme song for the series' 20th anniversary exhibition, Bleach EX. For The Separation cours, the opening theme song is "Stars", performed by , while the ending theme song is "", performed by Yoh Kamiyama. For The Conflict cours, the opening theme song is }}, performed by , while the ending theme song is "Monochrome", performed by .
In October 2022, Viz Media announced that the series would stream on Hulu in the United States and Disney+ internationally outside of Asia. The English dub of the series began streaming on Hulu in November of the same year. In April 2025, it was announced that the English dub would make its broadcast television premiere on Adult Swim's Toonami programming block beginning on May 18, 2025.

| ShortSummary    = Soul Reapers Ryūnosuke Yuki and Shino Madarame, arrive and visit Karakura Town, following the mass disappearances of Hollows from the Human World. They are ambushed by Hollows, but rescued by Ichigo Kurosaki, Orihime Inoue, Yasutora "Chad" Sado, and Uryū Ishida. Two days later, Ichigo meets Asguiaro Ebern, a member of the Wandenreich. Ebern attempts to use a Quincy medallion and seal Ichigo's Bankai, but he destroys it and makes him retreat. At the same time, a group of individuals representing the enemy faction called the Wandenreich, the Quincy Empire, infiltrate head captain Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto's office in the Soul Society, and deliver a fatally wounded lieutenant Chōjirō Sasakibe as an example for the impending fate of the Soul Reapers. Meanwhile, 11th squad members Ikkaku Madarame and Yumichika Ayasegawa, investigate the disappearances of thousands of civilians from the Rukon District. At the Wandenreich's base Silbern, Ebern reports to Yhwach, the Quincy King.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| AltDate         = May 25, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck and Pesche Guatiche go to the Human World, and inform Ichigo that Hueco Mundo has been invaded by the Wandenreich, after its leader Tier Halibel, the former 3rd Espada, was defeated by Yhwach. The Arrancars of Hueco Mundo have either joined the Quincies, captured, or killed. Kisuke Urahara, Ichigo, Orihime, Chad, Nel, and Pesche, arrive to Hueco Mundo. Meanwhile, the Wandenreich's hunting captain of the First Jagdarmee, Stern Ritter "J" Quilge Opie, tests the Arrancars to see who will join them. Loly and Menoly attempt to take an upper hand, but are dispatched easily. Tres Bestias: Emilou Apacci, Franceska Mila Rose, and Cyan Sung-Sun arrive for support, but are overwhelmed by Quilge.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| AltDate         = June 1, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo confronts Quilge. The Tres Bestias summon Ayon and re-join the fight against Quilge. Uryū learns the truth of the conflict between Soul Reapers and Quincies centuries ago. It is revealed that Squad 12 captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi ordered the elimination of all civilians from the Rukon District, in order to rectify the soul imbalance caused by the Quincies exterminating Hollows in the Living World. It is revealed that Yamamoto fought Yhwach 1,000 years ago. Quilge absorbs Reishi in the area (including from Ayon) and overpowers the Tres Bestias, but clashes with Ichigo once again when he activates his Bankai. When the Quincies begin the invasion of the Soul Society, Stern Ritter "H" Bazz-B, critically wounds Squad 3 Lieutenant Izuru Kira and kills three other Soul Reapers.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}

| AltDate         = June 8, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Over 1,000 Soul Reapers die within seven minutes of the Quincy's invasion. Squad 3 captain Rōjūrō "Rose" Ōtoribashi meets Stern Ritter "U" NaNaNa Najahkoop, Squad 6 captain Byakuya Kuchiki and lieutenant Renji Abarai face off against Stern Ritter "F" Äs Nödt and Stern Ritter "S" Mask De Masculine, and Squad 7 captain Sajin Komamura on Stern Ritter "E" Bambietta Basterbine. The other Soul Society captains confront unnamed Stern Ritters. As the fighting reaches a stalemate, the Squad 2 captain Soi-Fon, Byakuya, Komamura, and Squad 10 captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya release their Bankais, but they are stolen by their opponent Stern Ritters using absorbing medallions. The captains are shocked by the news that the Stern Ritters' trump card is to steal Bankais, as it is communicated to the rest of the Soul Society. Squad 8 captain, Shunsui Kyōraku is blinded in his right eye by Stern Ritter "N" Robert Accutrone. While Quilge fights against Ichigo, Urahara observes that the Stern Ritters failed to steal Ichigo's Bankai. Urahara opens the portal for Ichigo to enter there and join the fight. However, Quilge attacks Urahara, Orihime, and Chad, and uses his Stern Ritter ability, "The Jail", to trap Ichigo in the Garganta, preventing him from reaching the Soul Society.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| Aux2            = Mitsutoshi Satō
| Aux3            = Michio Hasegawa
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         = June 15, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo hears the voices of many Soul Reapers, while desperately attempting to escape from Quilge's Jail. Before Quilge can kill Urahrara and the others, he is ambushed and killed by an unseen assailant. Byakuya and Renji engage Äs Nödt in battle. Byakuya is unnerved by Äs, who awakened his fears with Reishi Thorns. Byakuya attempts to overcome his fear, but Äs overwhelms him with his own Bankai. Rukia and Renji are wounded by other Stern Ritters. Kenpachi Zaraki, having killed three of them (Stern Ritter "R" Jerome Guizbatt, Stern Ritter "Q" Berenice Gabrielli, and Stern Ritter "Y" Loyd Lloyd), confronts Yhwach and his right hand man, Jugram Haschwalth. Yamamoto saves Squad 9 lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi from Stern Ritter "O", Driscoll Berci. He reveals that he killed Sasakibe and stole his Bankai, Kōkō Gonryō Rikyū, with which he attacks Yamamoto. This reminds Yamamoto that he taught Sasakibe 2,000 years ago. The enraged Yamamoto kills Driscoll, saves Kenpachi from Yhwach, and inspires the Soul Reapers to keep fighting.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         = June 22, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Yamamoto engages Yhwach in battle at the Seireitei. When Yhwach moves away, Yamamoto activates his Bankai, Zanka no Tachi, which causes water to evaporate from the whole area. Squad 4 captain Retsu Unohana and her lieutenant Isane Kotetsu, are worried that if the battle goes on for too long, Yamamoto could destroy even the Soul Society. Yhwach is powerless against the various abilities of Zanka no Tachi, and Yamamoto boasts that his Bankai is too strong to be stolen. Yamamoto unknowingly defeats a fake replica, and the real Yhwach arrives and identifies him as the second half of the Lloyd twins, Stern Ritter "Y" Royd Lloyd. Yhwach destroys the Squad 1 barracks and kills Royd for his failure. Yhwach reveals he had visited Sousuke Aizen in his underground prison. Considered by the Wandenreich to be one of the Five Special War Powers, Yhwach tried to convince Aizen to join him, but he refused. Yamamoto attempts to use his Bankai again, but Yhwach steals it, being the only one to take it, and kills Yamamoto.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}

| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu

| Aux3            = Kumiko Takayanagi

| AltDate         = June 29, 2025
| ShortSummary    = A thousand years ago, the original Thirteen Court Guard Squads consisted of ruthless and barbaric killers with selfish purpose, who partook in killing the Wandenreich, and Yamamoto and Sasakibe defeated Yhwach. Afterwards, Yamamoto adopted a peaceful philosophy and formed a unified Court Guard system. Back in the present day, Yhwach destroys Yamamoto's remains. Ichigo breaks free and returns to the Soul Society for help. He trades blows with Yhwach, but is quickly defeated. Yhwach attempts to kill Ichigo, but is countered by him awakening a defensive Quincy technique called Blut Vëne. Yhwach reveals Quilge's Jail can only be broken by a Quincy, but Ichigo does not know the truth about himself or his mother, Masaki. Shadow portals appear to transport the Quincy back to Silbern and Yhwach realizes that Aizen used his Shikai ability on him to lose track of time. Ichigo tries to charge at Yhwach, but his Zanpakutō is destroyed by Haschwalth. Yhwach departs, cryptically referring to the stunned Ichigo as "his son, born in the dark".
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| DirectedBy      = Young-Hoon Jung
| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu
| Aux2            = Shinji Itadaki
| Aux3            = Kiyoshi Komatsubara
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         = July 20, 2025
| ShortSummary    = After the invasion, Rukia, Renji, and Kenpachi are treated by Squad 4, along with the surviving Soul Reapers as Byakuya barely clings to life. Mayuri tells Ichigo that as his Zanpakutō was destroyed while in Bankai state, it cannot be fixed. The captains mourn Yamamoto. Ichigo and the captains meet with Squad Zero, consisting of the five most elite former captains, who protect the Soul King in the Royal Palace. Ichigo and the captains, talk to Urahara, Orihime, and Chad, who were saved from Quilge by a concealed Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez. Kūkaku Shiba sends Ichigo, Byakuya, Renji, Rukia, and Squad Zero to the Royal Palace above the Seireitei, where Zangetsu could be reforged. Kūkaku, having sent them up to the Royal Palace, joins her brother Ganju, Kūgo Ginjō, Shūkurō Tsukishima, and Giriko Kutsuzawa, who now reside in the Soul Society, since they were killed with a Zanpakutō, given a proper burial, and did not become Hollows. At the Royal Palace, Ichigo, Rukia, Renji, and Byakuya, are being healed by Tenjirō Kirinji, a member of Squad Zero and the one who taught Unohana healing techniques. The Soul King is seen awakening.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| DirectedBy      = Kaito Asakura
| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu

| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         = July 27, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and Renji are healed completely by Kirinji. They move up to Kirio Hikifune's palace, where she feeds them with ancient Soul Society dishes, containing strong spiritual pressure, before being sent up to Ōetsu Nimaiya's palace, the man responsible for creating all Zanpakutō. Meanwhile, Squad 8 captain Shunsui Kyōraku is appointed to be head captain, his lieutenant Nanao Ise have joined the Squad 1 and Yamamoto's previous 3rd Seat Genshiro Okikiba, was also promoted to lieutenant. He decrees that Kenpachi is to be taught "zanjutsu" – an all-style encompassing swordsmanship by Squad 4 captain Unohana, who reveals herself a criminal for the history of the Soul Society and the founder of the Squad 11 and the "First Kenpachi", her real name being Yachiru Unohana. Unohana and Kenpachi fight at the underground prison, Muken. Kenpachi recalls how he used to admire Unohana, from their first meeting on, when he scarred her chest. Unohana states that he has become far weaker since then and she will push him to the brink of death and revive him repeatedly to unlock his full potential.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| AltDate         = August 3, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Hundreds of years ago, Unohana has grown bored of killing bandits in the hopes of finding a worthy opponent, until a vicious child, Kenpachi attacks her. Unohana is overpowered, so Kenpachi subconsciously begins to hold himself back, which ends in his defeat. Back in the present day, Unohana wounds Kenpachi hundreds of times, as he grows stronger each time he resurrects. She unleashes her Bankai, Minazuki, which allows her to extend her blade with acidic slashes resembling blood. Kenpachi has grown strong enough to power through and kill her. As he grieves Unohana, he finally gets to speak with his Zanpakutō and forge a bond. Meanwhile, Ichigo, Renji, and Kon, arrive in Nimaiya's palace, Hoohden, where they meet countless Zanpakutō spirits and the unconventional captain himself. Nimaiya teaches them about the basics of how Soul Reapers receive Zanpakutō in their base form, called Asauchi, which becomes a personalized Zanpakutō the more the wielder imprints his spiritual pressure on it. Nimaiya sends the two down into a hole filled with countless Asauchi and leaves them there for three days to fight them. Renji returns victorious from obtaining his partner, but Ichigo fails the test, unceremoniously being sent back to the Human World near his family house and citing that he must return to his roots, since he did not go through the training.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| AltDate         = August 10, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Nimaiya tells Renji that he forged every Zanpakutō over the past several thousand years, including Kenpachi's, which was taken from a dead Soul Reaper. However, Ichigo's Zanpakutō wasn't one of his Asauchi, making his training crucial. Ichigo visits Ikumi Unagiya but is taken away by his father, Isshin Kurosaki, in Soul Reaper form, leaving his badge behind. Isshin reveals that Ichigo's mother, Masaki, was a Quincy. Nearly 20 years ago, as captain of Squad 10, Isshin investigated Soul Reaper deaths in Naraki City caused by a powerful Hollow named "White", created from multiple dead Soul Reapers' souls. Masaki, an Echt Quincy raised by Sōken Ishida's family, sensed the Hollow's presence and intervened despite protests from Ryūken and the family maid Kanae. While battling the Hollow, Isshin was wounded by Aizen, Gin Ichimaru, and Kaname Tōsen, who had created "White". Masaki saved Isshin, defeating the Hollow at the cost of triggering its self-destruction. Isshin protected her and learned she was a Quincy. Fearing rejection, Masaki was relieved when Isshin warmly accepted her. Ryūken and Kanae, seeing she was safe, left her. Back in the present day, Haschwalth meets Uryū.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| DirectedBy      = Young-Hoon Jung
| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu
| Aux2            = Shinji Itadaki & Kentarō Tokiwa
| Aux3            = Michio Hasegawa
| OriginalAirDate = }}
| AltDate         = August 17, 2025
| ShortSummary    = Isshin continues telling Ichigo his story. After the mission, he reported to Yamamoto but left out Masaki's involvement. Drawn to her, he continued patrolling the Human World. Meanwhile, Masaki began feeling the effects of the Hollow soul that had merged with her, collapsing as a Hollow hole appeared on her chest. Berated by Ryūken's mother for helping a Soul Reaper, Masaki was taken for help by Ryūken, who blamed Isshin for her condition. Urahara intervened, explaining he had a cure that he discovered during his hundred-year exile while studying the Visoreds. Unlike Soul Reapers, Quincies lack resistance to Hollow souls, so Masaki's powerful Quincy soul needed the presence of a full Soul Reaper's powers to stabilize her for life. Isshin volunteered, and Urahara gave him a special Gigai to seal his powers and make him human. Isshin and Masaki later fell in love, while Ryūken married Kanae Katagiri. Isshin reveals the reason that Masaki died while fighting the Grand Fisher, and Katagiri died from her illness was because of Yhwach, who nine years earlier used Auswählen to absorb the powers of several Quincies he deemed to be impure. Before leaving, Ichigo retrieves his badge from Ikumi. Meanwhile, Ryūken discovers evidence that Uryū has met with the Stern Ritters.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| DirectedBy      = Tomohisa Taguchi, Mitsutoshi Satō& Yoshinori Odaka
| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu
| Aux2            = Tomohisa Taguchi
| Aux3            = Kumiko Takayanagi
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = One of Nimaiya's Zanpakutō bodyguards sends Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to continue training. There, all the Asauchi kneel to him, and he selects the correct one: "White", the Hollow within him. Meanwhile, in Soul Society, the captains and lieutenants begin training. Hitsugaya returns to the training grounds to improve his swordsmanship. Kensei Muguruma has his unofficial lieutenant Mashiro Kuna train with Hisagi to help him awaken his Bankai. Akon, recovering from injuries, returns to the Squad 12 barracks and learns that Mayuri and lieutenant Nemu have locked themselves inside the lab, working on a mysterious project. Captain Komamura seeks out his clan elder in order to learn a secret technique, and Soi-Fon trains alone in the mountains. Back at the Royal Palace, Nimaiya begins forging Ichigo's new Zanpakutō, revealing that "White", the Hollow, is his true Zanpakutō. "Old Man Zangetsu", resembling Yhwach from a thousand years ago, represents Ichigo's latent Quincy powers and has been suppressing his Soul Reaper powers to protect him. Ichigo speaks with Old Man Zangetsu one final time; Zangetsu expresses pride in Ichigo's growth and relinquishes control, allowing Ichigo to access his true dual-bladed Shikai: the True Zangetsu. Each blade embodies both "White" and "Old Man Zangetsu", and Ichigo embraces them as part of himself. In Silbern, Yhwach meets with Haschwalth, who presents Uryū, now wearing Stern Ritter attire.
| LineColor       = AC1E1B
}}
| DirectedBy      = Hikaru Murata
| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu
| Aux2            = Tomohisa Taguchi, Hikaru Murata& Yusaku Kikuchi
| Aux3            = Kiyoshi Komatsubara
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo begins his training with Ichibe'e Hyōsube, the captain of Squad Zero. Meanwhile, Yhwach gathers the Quincy army to announce that he has chosen Uryū as his successor, causing discord between many of the Stern Ritters who considered Haschwalth more worthy for the post. Askin Nakk Le Vaar stops the ruckus between other ones, specifically Bazz-B and Haschwalth. Orihime and Chad train at Hueco Mundo, while Urahara researches the Quincy Medallion. Ichibe'e leads Ichigo to a special place in the Royal Palace, which can only be accessed with permission from the Soul King, in order to make him stronger. New Head Captain Shunsui Kyōraku gives Ichigo's human friends a Soul Ticket into the Soul Society in case Ichigo's spiritual pressure becomes too much for the Human World to bear. Rukia and Renji continue their training in the Royal Palace, while Byakuya recovers with Kirinji's help. A dark dome engulfs the Seireitei and the Quincy army returns for the next battle. Yhwach declares that he will retake the world in the next nine days, as per the Quincy Song, the Kaiser Gesang.
| LineColor       = 1335A9
}}
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = The Wandenreich begin their second invasion of the Seireitei. Haschwalth orders the Stern Ritters who stole Bankais to defeat the captains they stole them from. Askin arrives in the 12th Squad barracks and explains that the Quincy hideout, the Wandenreich was created with Quincy powers, and is hidden within the shadows of the Seireitei, from where they watched, and studied everything and everyone. Mayuri and Nemu emerge from the former's secret lab, which was hidden in complete brightness, where he devised the countermeasures against the Quincy transportation techniques. Annoyed by Mayuri's absurdity and tenaciousness, Askin leaves. Haschwalth confronts Shunsui and Nanao personally, but the latter has devised a powerful Kido spell to hold the Stern Ritter back. The Soul Reapers and Soldats are in all-out war on the streets of the Seireitei. Squad 10 captain Toshiro Hitsugaya and lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto confront Bazz-B. Meanwhile, Squad 2 lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda tries to protect his little sister from Stern Ritter "K" BG9, but captain Soi Fon arrives to protect them. Hitsugaya and Rangiku use underhanded tactics, such as combining their abilities to stop Bazz-B in his tracks, but they cannot compete with his powers. Bazz-B effortlessly beats Hitsugaya, but Stern Ritter "I" Cang Du steps in to eliminate him with his own stolen Bankai. BG9 greatly wounds Soi Fon as well. Suddenly, Urahara contacts Mayuri and reveals that he devised a way to retrieve the stolen Bankais.
| LineColor       = 1335A9
}}
| Aux3            = Kumiko Takayanagi
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = Cang Du reveals that he's already defeated Rangiku and tries to finish off Hitsugaya using his stolen Bankai. Urahara arrives at the Squad 12 barracks and tells Mayuri he's developed a method to recover stolen Bankais by using the Shin'eiyaku — a black pill that hollowfies a Bankai, making it poisonous to Quincies. He discovered this weakness after observing Quilge's inability to properly control Arrancar Reishi. The pills are immediately sent to all Bankai users. Hitsugaya takes the pill, regains his hollowfied Bankai and defeats Cang Du before collapsing. BG9 tries to harvest the unconscious Soi-Fon, but Ōmaeda gives her the pill, and she defeats BG9 with her Bankai. Elsewhere, Squad 5 captain Shinji Hirako is surrounded by Soldats after his squad is slain. He activates his Bankai, Sakashima Yokoshima Happō Fusagari, which makes enemies and allies indistinguishable, causing the Soldats to kill each other. Yumichika, Hisagi, and Ikkaku take the Shin'eiyaku but are suddenly attacked by Stern Ritter "S" Mask de Masculine, who easily overpowers them. Meanwhile, Stern Ritter "E" Bambietta Basterbine searches for captain Komamura. She unleashes her explosive power just as Komamura, now in full armor, arrives to stop her. Shinji briefly stalls her with his Shikai to let Komamura proceed on his mission to avenge Yamamoto. All fallen Stern Ritters begin activating their Quincy Vollständig. Meanwhile, in the Soul Palace, Ichigo enters a dark corridor filled with pain, pressure, and visions of a man submerged in Reishi, gradually revealing the Soul King.
| LineColor       = 1335A9
}}
| DirectedBy      = Shinichirō Ueda
| WrittenBy       = Masaki Hiramatsu
| Aux2            = Shinichirō Ueda
| Aux3            = Kiyoshi Komatsubara
| OriginalAirDate =
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = Bambietta immediately blows up Shinji with her Vollständig powers. Komamura and 5th Squad lieutenant Momo Hinamori step in and the latter takes Shinji away, while the former protects their escape. Bambietta explains that her ability is not bombs, but to explode anything her Reishi projectiles touch, which cannot be defended against. She blows Komamura's helmet away, revealing his new human form. Komamura explains that he gained his clans secret Humanization Technique by ripping his own heart out and sacrificing it to the clan elder. As such, Komamura is virtually immortal and invulnerable while in human form. Komamura uses his Bankai, which is also invulnerable now without its armor, to slam Bambietta with her own exploding Reishi projectiles. Komamura hurries toward Yhwach, but his heart gives out and he turns into a completely non-human wolf form, unable to speak as his lieutenant, Tetsuzaemon Iba carries him away. The defeated Bambietta is found by the other female Sternritters and begs for her life, while the defeated Cang Du and BG9 are collected by Uryū. Haschwalth returns to Yhwach's side as well. Mask defeats his opponents as well, after support from his fan James. Before he could kill them though, Mask is stopped by the arrival of 9th Squad captain Kensei Muguruma and 3rd Squad captain Rōjūrō "Rose" Ōtoribashi. Meanwhile, Ichibe'e tells Ichigo that he is experiencing the past of the Soul Society within the powers of the Soul King. Ichigo successfully passes through the corridor gate and goes to Senjumaru Shutara's palace.
| LineColor       = 1335A9
}}
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = Shunsui orders the remaining Soul Reapers to regroup under Mayuri's coordination. Kensei activates his Bankai, Tekken Tachikaze, to fight Mask de Masculine, but after a brief victory, Mask recovers due to being empowered by James' cheering and critically injures Kensei. Hisagi warns that James is the key to Mask's sudden recovery. Rose seemingly kills James and uses his Bankai, Kinshara Butōdan, which creates illusions through sound. Mask, realizing this, bursts his eardrums and defeats Rose. Before Mask can kill both captains, Renji arrives and easily blocks his attack. Rukia appears as well; both have completed Squad 0 training and become much stronger. Rukia takes the wounded captains to Kotetsu for treatment, while Renji faces Mask, unaffected by his attacks. It's also revealed that James is still alive and is continuing to cheer on Mask, who activates his Vollständig and unleashes his strongest Reishi blast, unintentionally incinerating his fan for good. Renji blocks it using his true, complete Bankai, Sō-ō Zabimaru, which he can now wield fully after being rejected by Zabimaru before. He uses the technique Sō-ō Zabimaru: Zāgā Tēppō to permanently eliminate Mask. In Silbern, Yhwach absorbs Mask's Reishi in front of Uryū before disappearing into a shadow, from which Haschwalth emerges. When Uryū questions his presence, Haschwalth explains that all Quincies are connected to Yhwach. As Uryū is now Yhwach's chosen successor, Haschwalth decides to reveal the truth about Yhwach's nature and the origin of his powers.
| LineColor       = 1335A9
}}
| AltDate         =
| ShortSummary    = After completing his training with Squad Zero, Ichigo begins descending to the Seireitei and informs Urahara of his arrival. Uryū discovers Haschwalth killing BG9 and Cang Du for their failure. Haschwalth reveals that all those who are given a portion of Yhwach's soul have their powers, knowledge, and skills, absorbed by Yhwach along with their soul upon dying. As Rukia scouts around the Seireitei, she confronts Stern Ritter "F" Äs Nödt, who is looking for Byakuya's Senbonzakura. As she is much stronger now and has learned what her Zanpakutō really does, specifically its ability to lower its users temperature and anything she touches to absolute zero, she manages to freeze Äs. Angered by Rukia's dismissal of fear, Äs activates his Quincy Vollständig, which transmits fear just upon the sight of his grotesque body. When she is trapped because of a moment of fear, Byakuya steps in to recognize her growth. Äs taunts Byakuya, but he allows Rukia to stand on her own. She unleashes her dangerous Bankai, Hakka no Togame, to defeat Äs. Byakuya helps Rukia control her power, so she will not sacrifice herself. While tending to Rose and Kensei, Isane and 11th Squad lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi are ambushed by a Stern Ritter.

| ShortSummary    = As a child, Shunsui Kyōraku often visited his older brother and his wife, the head of the Ise clan, a matriarchal family of priests cursed so that all male members die young. He conceals it inside his second Zanpakutō spirit, Okyo, created by Ohana, his first Zanpakutō spirit. The Central 46 sentences Nanao's mother to death for losing the sacred treasure. Nanao later enrolls in the Soul Reaper Academy, excelling at Kido and nearly joining the Kido Corps, but is instead assigned to Squad 8, where she unknowingly reunites with her uncle, Shunsui, who mentors her.
